What are some helpful study tips, tricks, and techniques?

I assume you mean for some kind of exam. Obviously get started early. Learn all content if you haven't already in class, making notes, flashcards etc. If you are studying for an exam or test and there are past papers of that same subject, if you are confident you could do well or pretty average on one, then do all the ones you can find. Go through them question by question with the mark scheme, if you know something, answer the question and write it down, if you don't use the mark scheme and write down what you don't know on paper, this should leave you with a page or pages of notes on content you didn't know and by writing it down you learn it. I would also recommend writind down the topics that you are weak on so you can amend them as a whole. If there are lots of papers for a subject, you should know everything by doing them all, if not, then yiu may have to supplement your learning further through methods such as note making and flashcards, if you have no past exam papers for your subject, you may have to rely solely on this method, flashcards are good as they allow you to test yourself. Learn what you don't know and redo the papers, this can be reapeated until your knowledge is solid. This also works for cramming, if you don't have much time, don't bother with note making, just get straight to the past papers and go through them in much the same way, this time if you know an answer just think of it and check the mark scheme to make sure you've got it, only write down things you don't know, try to do as many as possible before the exam.

I use anki a lot. It lets you memorize lots of stuff in a relatively short timespan. Really improved my studying.

Also: start early!
